title:
CALL SOMEONE YOU LOVE
JERUSALEM
beats: 'Hello, Shalom Aleichem. How are you, my sweet daughter?'
'I miss you so much. I love you. I hope to see you before I die. God bless you and save you, for you and your children.'
'I love you, my sweet daughter. Take care and God bless you.'
'I hope we will meet again. America is not far - any time, we can be close together.'
THE CLOSE: 'Take care and God bless you. Bye-bye, darling. I love you.'
